summary: Frontend-only end-to-end retest after main agent's font URL fix (Playfair Display v37 -> v40) and theming of the two previously cream cards (cashProtection, assumptionsCard). RESULT: All 7 requested flows PASS. App loads cleanly with no blank/white screen, no console errors (only pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings). Welcome renders 'Jaleter' + 'SMART BUDGETING. WEALTHY LIVING.' + Get Started + Log in link. Full onboarding chain Welcome->Onboarding(Both)->Signup(pw+terms+create)->FirstConnect(skip)->Paywall(preview)->Home works. All 5 bottom nav tabs render without red-screen. Dark mode: Settings->Dark makes page bg rgb(17,17,15)=#11110f on Home/NetWorth and card-toned rgb(26,25,22) on Budget/Transactions/More; persists across all 5 tabs and all 3 More sub-screens (Legacy rgb(19,18,16), Coaching rgb(17,17,15), Membership rgb(17,17,15)). Light restores rgb(250,248,243)=#faf8f3 cream across every tab. Transactions add opens sheet, saves 'Test Coffee $4.99' -> row visible in list. Budget give category defaults to EXPANDED (Tithe/Missions/Extra Giving shown), tapping once collapses, second tap re-expands (test toggle verified both directions). Net Worth eye toggle replaces $ values with dots. No red-box crashes anywhere.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native for Web deprecation warning still emitted: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking but noisy. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx lines ~900-1060 (snapshotCard, worthCard, and other card styles use shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius).
React Native for Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (search pointerEvents=).

action_items: No functional issues remain — MVP acceptance criteria for the dark-mode + font-URL fix iteration are met. Main agent can consider this bug closed.
Optional cleanup: migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
Optional refactor (carried over from iteration_1): /app/frontend/app/index.tsx is >1060 lines — should be split into per-screen modules (violates <700 line rule).
critical_code_review_comments: Font URL fix is minimal and correct — v40 CDN paths (nuFvD-vYSZviVYUb_rj3ij__anPXJzDwcbmjWBN2PKd3vUDQ.ttf & ...PKebukDQ.ttf) both return 200 and load without errors.
cashProtection (index.tsx:526) and assumptionsCard (index.tsx:579) now apply t.dark/t.cardBg overrides — they no longer appear as cream panels on dark mode.
Budget give category is intentionally seeded expanded via useState(['give']); prior iteration test reports should note this so future testers don't mistake single-tap collapse for a broken expand.
seed_data_creation: None. Cleared localStorage['jaleter-state-v1'] to reset onboarding stage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding stage is persisted to localStorage key 'jaleter-state-v1'. To retest onboarding, run: await page.evaluate('() => localStorage.clear()') then reload. Viewport 390x844. All testIDs from review request are wired: welcome-get-started, welcome-login, onboarding-continue, signup-password/terms/create, connect-skip, paywall-preview, nav-home/budget/transactions/networth/more, more-settings/legacy/coaching/membership, settings-appear-Dark/Light, tx-add/name/amount/save, budget-cat-give (NOTE: give is expanded by default; single tap collapses, second tap re-expands), nw-eye. header-back testID exists on More sub-screens.
rca_of_issue: The user-perceived 'blank/white screen' from the prior iteration was caused by 2 network 404s on Playfair Display Google Fonts URLs (v37 hash-path no longer exists on fonts.gstatic.com). Main agent replaced them with v40 URLs (index.tsx layout _layout.tsx lines 13-14). Verified: no font-related console errors, brand text 'Jaleter' renders in the serif face on Welcome. Combined with prior iteration_1 fix (useThemed() added to NetWorthScreen & LegacyScreen), the app now completes the full onboarding->home->dark-mode acceptance flow without any red-box, blank screen, or unthemed cream panels.
